description: Suggest a focused public companion-code, project, test, or documentation improvement

## Request type

- [ ] New/expanded manuscript-aligned companion example
- [ ] Master-project improvement
- [ ] Test/quality improvement
- [ ] Accessibility improvement
- [ ] Documentation/tooling improvement
- [ ] Other public repository enhancement

## Problem or learning goal

What reader/developer problem should this solve?

## Proposed scope

Describe the smallest useful change. Include the affected part/project if known.

## Why it belongs in this repository

Explain how the request supports Dart/Flutter learning, repository quality, or the published series.

## Alternatives considered

Could the same goal be met with an existing example/project or without a new dependency?

## Dependency/platform impact

List any proposed third-party packages, platform capabilities, or minimum SDK changes.

## Testing expectations

Describe how the feature could be verified deterministically.

## Additional context

Do not include secrets, private user data, or paid publication files.
